entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Managing Dir. Of National Highways Authority Of India
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Abdul Samad,Sunil Sharma
Counsel for Respondent :- Sarvesh Kumar Dubey,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of the State Respondents and Sri Sarvesh Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the respondent- National Highway Authority of India.

This petition has been filed with the following main prayer:-
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the opposite parties to pay the compensation of the Land Gata No-1387, 1388, 1402,
1404 which are situated at Village Jhakrasi Pargana and Tahsil Sadar, District- Rae Bareli to the Petitioner in the interest of justice."
Meera Devi vs Managing Dir. Of National Highways ... on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117817096/
1

entities.text: Meera Devi vs Managing Dir. Of National Highways
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Standing Counsel has produced before this Court instructions sent by the Additional District Magistrate (Judicial)/ Special Land Acquisition Officer, Raebareli, wherein it has been stated that there is a dispute regarding apportionment of compensation, as at the time when Section 3A Notification was issued under the National Highways Act, the name of the petitioner Meera Devi W/o Umesh Shukla, was not mentioned in the revenue record to 1420-1425 Fasli.

entities.text: Additional District Magistrate (Judicial)/ Special Land Acquisition Officer, Raebareli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The Civil Court,
Raebareli, is also seized of the matter, with regard to Gata Nos.1387, 1388 and 1402 and the compensation determined for such gatas has been deposited in the Court concerned.
This petition is disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to move an appropriate application under Section 3H of the National Highways Act, 1956.
Order Date :- 1.10.2024 Rahul  Meera Devi vs Managing Dir. Of National Highways ...
